causeNote: Owner 1:1 grade of ob/open.png and control/open.png (604x1024 canvas, jaw held at JAW_OPEN_TEETH_CLEAR_RADIANS + viseme_aa=1): both actors show the teeth as one flat white slab filling the mouth with a pink tongue band; OB also shows a black crescent at image-right. Shipped GLB (gltf-transform, both actors): openclinxr_hm08_teeth_* is 136 verts, material baseColorFactor [0.92,0.9,0.86] with NO baseColorTexture and NO normalTexture, 0 morph targets, skinned 100% to head. Runtime: same material with map=false/normalMap=false (MeshStandardMaterial #f6f3ef), so the loader does not drop a texture; the bake never wrote one. rebind-head-locked-teeth.ts moves the lower half to jaw at runtime (topBones head 0.507 / jaw 0.493; teeth bbox centre moved 0.038 m OB, 0.028 m control), so morph_not_driving_teeth is ruled out. Mouth cavity: OB carries runtime-added openclinxr_inner_mouth_cavity + _palate (MeshBasicMaterial #b34752) but they were visible=false at capture: inner-mouth-cavity-drive.ts shows them when the NAMED drive's jawOpenRadians > 0.05, and this probe set the jaw bone directly, so their hidden state is a probe artifact, not a finding. Control has no cavity meshes. Per card STEP1: cause is glb_bake_*, so report and stop; a teeth-texture rebake is a separate card. Secondary, not classified: control lacks the runtime cavity meshes.
